title: Guests
description: The invited households, their invitation links and the replies received.
contactsHidden: Guest contact details are visible only to the owner and the project manager.

add.title: A new household
add.intro: A household (or a single guest) gets one link and replies once for everyone in it.

fields.name: Name on the invitation
fields.adultsHint: One name per line. Adults only — for children the guest only says how many are coming.
fields.partySizeHint: Children included. Leave empty if you don't know yet.
fields.emailHint: If you have it, you can send the invitation directly. Otherwise we ask for it, optionally, when they reply.
fields.languageHint: The link opens in this language; the guest can switch in one tap.
fields.notesHint: Guests never see notes. Don't write details about children here.

empty.title: You have not invited anyone yet
empty.body: Add the first household or import the list from an Excel or CSV file. Each household gets its own invitation link.

email.title: Send the invitations by email
email.body: Households that have an email and have not received the invitation yet: {count}.
email.confirmBody: Each household receives a new link by email. If you already gave them the link another way, that one will stop working.
email.done: Sent. You can send at most 500 emails a day for one occasion.

link.title: Invitation link
link.onceBody: Copy it now and send it to the household. For safety we cannot show it again later — but you can generate a new one at any time.
link.expiryNoDeadline: At the reply deadline (not set yet)
link.hashedNote: We do not keep the link in readable form, so we cannot show it again. If it is lost, generate a new one.
link.expiryTitle: How long the link is valid
link.expiryHint: After it expires, the link behaves like one that does not exist.
link.revokeBody: The link will stop working for everyone. The reply already received stays. You can generate a new link at any time.

detail.noResponse: The household has not replied yet.
detail.childrenHint: The number only. We never note names or ages.
detail.recordIntro: For replies received by phone or in person.
detail.adultsNote: Only adults are listed here. Children appear only as a number, in the household's reply.
detail.contactNote: Visible only to the owner and the project manager.
detail.removeTitle: Remove the household from the list
detail.removeBody: We first show you what changes: the link, the places held and what they promised to bring. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.
detail.removeButton: See what changes if I remove it

settings.title: Reply settings
settings.description: The reply deadline, the number of places and the questions guests receive.
settings.deadlineHint: Guests can reply and change their reply until the end of this day. Leave empty if you have no deadline.
settings.capacityHint: Places already taken: {taken}. Leave empty for unlimited places. The same places are shared with public registrations.

questions.title: Questions for guests
questions.description: Guests get them one at a time, one per screen, after saying whether they come.
questions.intro: Write the question the way you would ask a friend.
questions.textEnHint: If left empty, guests reading in English see the Romanian text.
questions.optionsHint: One per line. For accommodation and transport you may leave it empty: Yes / No is used. Allergies and free answers need none.
questions.optionsEnHint: In the same order as in Romanian.
questions.emptyBody: Guests only say whether they come and how many they are. Add a question about the menu, allergies, accommodation or transport.
questions.childrenNote: Do not ask for details about children (names, ages). We keep only how many children come, and answers that seem to contain such details get a warning.

import.title: Import the guest list
import.description: From an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. You first see what changes; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.uploadBody: One row for each adult, with a column for the household. The first line must hold the column names.
import.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, 2 MB and {max} rows at most.
import.childrenNote: We do not import data about children. Columns with ages or birth dates are left out.
import.failed: We could not read the file
import.gone: This preview no longer exists. Upload the file again.
import.alreadyDecided: This import has already been applied or cancelled. You can upload another file.
import.mappingBody: Rows found: {count}. Check that we matched the columns correctly.
import.childColumnsTitle: Some columns will not be imported
import.childColumnsBody: They seem to hold data about children or sensitive personal data: {columns}. About children we keep only their number, given by the household when it replies.

skip.childDetails: Seems to contain details about a child.
skip.badEmail: The email address is not valid; the rest of the row is imported.

import.linksNote: New households each get an invitation link. Generate it from the household's page, or send the invitations by email.

errors.empty: The file is empty or has only the line with the column names.
errors.tooBig: The file is too big. The limit is 2 MB.
errors.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows. The limit is {max}.
errors.unreadable: We could not read the file. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
errors.childColumn: This column seems to hold data about children and cannot be imported.
errors.needNameColumn: Choose the column with the adult's name or the one with the household.

errors.capacityBelowTaken: {taken} places are already taken. The total cannot be lower.
